# 1. Base case

```{r}
Summary_base_case_20251223 <- import(here("Results/Summary/Summary_base_case_20251223.xlsx"))
```


```{r}
#| label: tbl-basecase
#| tbl-cap: "Performance metrics for base case scenarios" 

basecase_table <- Summary_base_case_20251223 %>% 
  mutate("Bias of est_V (MCSE)" = paste0(round(bias_est_V,3), " (", round(bias_est_V_MCSE,3), ")"),
         "Bias of VE (MCSE)" = paste0(round(bias_VE,3), " (", round(bias_VE_MCSE,3), ")"),
         "Empirical SE of est_V (MCSE)" = paste0(round(se_est_V_hat,3), " (", round(se_est_V_hat_MCSE,3), ")"),
         "Coverage of 95% CI of VE (MCSE)" = paste0(round(coverage_irr_V,3), " (", round(coverage_irr_V_MCSE,3), ")")) %>%
  select(sample_size, "Bias of est_V (MCSE)",  "Empirical SE of est_V (MCSE)", "Bias of VE (MCSE)",  "Coverage of 95% CI of VE (MCSE)") %>% rename("Cohort size" = sample_size)
  
kable(basecase_table)
```

# 2. Misspecifying control and focal window

```{r}
all_scens <- import(here("Results/Summary/Summary_all_scens_20251223.xlsx"))

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-misspecification
#| tbl-cap: "Performance metrics for scenarios of misspecifying focal and control windows" 


all_scens <- all_scens %>% 
  mutate("Bias of est_V (MCSE)" = paste0(round(bias_est_V,3), " (", round(bias_est_V_MCSE,3), ")"),
         "Relative bias of est_V (MCSE)" = paste0(round(abs(relative_bias_est_V),3), " (", round(relative_bias_est_V_MCSE,3), ")"),
         "Bias of VE (MCSE)" = paste0(round(bias_VE,3), " (", round(bias_VE_MCSE,3), ")"),
         "Empirical SE of est_V (MCSE)" = paste0(round(se_est_V_hat,3), " (", round(se_est_V_hat_MCSE,3), ")"),
         "Coverage of 95% CI of VE (MCSE)" = paste0(round(coverage_irr_V,3), " (", round(coverage_irr_V_MCSE,3), ")"),
         scen = factor(scen, levels = c("misspecify_control", "misspecify_risk_sta", "misspecify_risk_end", "seasonality"),
                       labels = c("Misspecify control window",
                                  "Misspecify start of risk window",
                                  "Misspecify end of risk window",
                                  "Seasonality")))  %>% 
  rename("Cohort size" = sample_size,
         "Scenario" = scen) %>%
  arrange(Scenario, "Cohort size")

misspecify_table <- all_scens %>%
  select(Scenario, "Cohort size", "Bias of est_V (MCSE)",  "Relative bias of est_V (MCSE)", "Bias of VE (MCSE)", "Coverage of 95% CI of VE (MCSE)") %>%
  filter(Scenario != "Seasonality") 

kable(misspecify_table)
```


# 3. Time-varying confounding effect of seasonality

```{r}
#| label: tbl-seasonality
#| tbl-cap: "Performance metrics for scenarios of Time-varying confounding effect of seasonality"
#| tbl-colwidths: [30, 14, 14, 14, 14, 14]

seasonality_table <- all_scens %>% filter(Scenario == "Seasonality") %>%
  mutate(infect_dist_id = case_when(base_infect_shape == 2.5 ~ 1,
                             base_infect_shape == 20 ~ 2,
                             TRUE ~ 3),
  vacc_dist_id = case_when(vacc_mean_d == 180 & vacc_sd_d == 60 ~ 1,
                           vacc_mean_d == 180 & vacc_sd_d == 20 ~ 2,
                           vacc_mean_d == 80 & vacc_sd_d == 60 ~ 3,
                           vacc_mean_d == 80 & vacc_sd_d == 20 ~ 4)
) %>% 
 mutate("Baseline infection risk distribution - Vaccination date distribution" = paste0(infect_dist_id,"-", vacc_dist_id)) %>% 
 arrange(infect_dist_id, vacc_dist_id, "Cohort size") %>%
 select("Baseline infection risk distribution - Vaccination date distribution", "Cohort size", "Bias of est_V (MCSE)",  "Relative bias of est_V (MCSE)", "Bias of VE (MCSE)", "Coverage of 95% CI of VE (MCSE)")

kable(seasonality_table)
```
